title: When to Replace Wet Drywall Instead of Drying It
description: When to replace wet drywall: how long it stayed wet, what kind of water it was, and whether it has lost strength decide it.
author: Example Restoration Co.

faqs.question: Can drywall be dried in place?
faqs.answer: Often, when clean water reached it quickly and it has not lost strength.
